definitions.explanation: Supernatural power to make impossible things happen. Used for both fictional magic and figuratively for something seemingly miraculous.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、{魔法|まほう}が{使|つか}えたらいいなと{思|おも}っていた。
examples.english: When I was a child, I wished I could use magic.

examples.japanese: まるで{魔法|まほう}のように{痛|いた}みが{消|き}えた。
examples.english: The pain disappeared as if by magic.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魔法|まほう}をかける (cast a spell)
- {魔法|まほう}が{解|と}ける (a spell is broken)
- {魔法|まほう}を{使|つか}う (use magic)
- {魔法|まほう}のように (as if by magic)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {魔法使|まほうつか}い (magician, wizard)
- {魔法|まほう}の{杖|つえ} (magic wand)
- {魔法瓶|まほうびん} (thermos — literally "magic bottle")

Often appears in fantasy fiction and fairy tales. {魔法瓶|まほうびん} (thermos) is a notable everyday compound that uses this word.
